description: All versions live in gradle/libs.versions.toml (single source of truth — no intra-repo drift possible, so no drift gate needed here). Renovate's value in this repo is prompt upgrade PRs, which also shrinks the cross-repo divergence window with revenue-protection-engine (the resilience4j boot3/boot4 split class of drift).

packageRules.description: Batch patch+minor into one weekly PR — one-operator review load
Majors stay individual PRs — the version catalog's VERIFY-BEFORE-BUILD discipline applies
